profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
- Experienced mobile application developer with over 8 years of experience developing mobile applications for Android, iOS and Windows Phone.

- Certiifed Xamarin Developer

- Over 10 self-published applications (some since deprecated) on the Google Play market as well as the Windows Phone marketplace. Combined, these applications have thousands of active users.

- Over 5 years experience developing RESTful backend web services on a variety of platforms including ASP.NET, Java Servlet/Tomcat, Python Django, and ASP.NET Web API, and NodeJS.

- Over 6 years experience developing native mobile application front-ends that comply with platform design standards for Windows Phone, Android, and iOS

- Over 3 years of experience designing databases in MySQL which support the mobile applications mentioned above.

Github:
https://github.com/BryceBrown

positions.title: Senior Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Developed a System for integrating with UPS and Fedex to automatically generate shipping labels for inventory logistics.
Updated and maintained an existing Xamarin Android application to work with additional hardware scanners for inventory management

positions.title: Senior Mobile Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained multiple Xamarin Native (Android and iOS) applications
- Provided high level technical guidance on the Android version of the Outback Android application
- Contributed to a multi concept application architecture
- Implemented both continuous deployment and continuous integration for multiple Xamarin applications
- Part of the team that developed the Outback Application which won the 2016 Xammy for Consumer applications

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and improved functionality for  existing applications on the iOS iPad platform 
https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/smartlane/id686173091?mt=8
Converted existing webservice into a RESTful webservice based on ASP.NET Web API 2
Developed and maintained multiple web pages based on ASP.NET and AngularJS
Designed and implemented a new system for creating dealership-branded mobile applications, including functional applications for both iOS and Android
Led a team of several mobile developers both architecturally and from a product requirements standpoint

positions.title: Technical Support
positions.description:
Server Administration
Telecom installation and support
Database projects
Team project experience in a task-oriented environment
Java Projects involving SWING
